dossier.scp_unleashed.253.title: Blue Overgrowth
dossier.scp_unleashed.253.caption: An affected subject in the observation cell, late in the course.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: The sample of SCP-253 is held in a single sealed vial inside a powered cold locker. Sealed glass is a complete barrier. The vial is never opened outside a sealed cell, and nobody enters that cell without a full hazmat suit.
Anyone who has stood in sight of an open sample is to be swabbed and the swab read in an analyzer. A positive subject is kept apart from other staff, kept fed, and handled by no one who can avoid it.
**There is no remedy.** A subject who falls, by any cause, is to be left where they lie until staff in full hazmat suits have cleared the room.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-253 is a cloudy blue fluid recovered as a single sealed vial. Sealed, it is inert. Open, it reaches any person within sixteen metres with an unobstructed line to the sample. Solid material between the subject and the sample prevents exposure entirely; a full hazmat suit is sufficient protection. A hood alone is not.

Within minutes the subject develops small, hard nodules on the skin: blue-grey, faceted like cut crystal and cold to the touch. Subjects report no pain. Over the following half hour the nodules multiply and grow, and the subject becomes steadily slower, as though the growths weigh far more than they should, and steadily hungrier. Late-stage subjects eat almost without pause and still fall behind.

Untreated, the condition runs its course in roughly half an hour, and the growths close over the subject, who does not get up again. Whenever a carrier falls, the growths crumble to a fine blue dust that is itself infective at close range.
A blow struck by a carrier passes SCP-253 to whoever it lands on. A full hazmat suit does not prevent this.

page.title: Addendum 253-1: Field Note
text: Staff report that new nodules can be heard forming in a quiet room: a faint crackle, like ice settling. Late-stage subjects breathe heavily even at rest.
Keep the kitchen open. %rSubject D-2531 requested a second ration eleven times in one shift.%r

page.title: Addendum 253-2: Provenance
text: SCP-253 was not recovered. It was handed to a reader of this file by the individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects.
Asked about the vial, the individual said only that it was patient. %rMeaning unclear.%r See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp253.1: A sealed sample of SCP-253: a cloudy blue fluid. While the seal holds it is completely inert.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp253.2: An open sample reaches anyone within %1$s blocks with a clear line of sight. Solid blocks stop it. A gas mask or hood alone is not enough: only a full hazmat suit keeps it out.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp253.3: Blue growths spread across the exposed over about %2$s minutes. They grow slower, and hungrier, the further it goes. Only a swab read in an analyzer confirms it early on.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp253.4: Blows struck by a carrier pass it on, suit or no suit. When a carrier falls, what crumbles away is still live.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp253.5: Players, villagers and D-Class can carry it, and so can anything a carrier strikes. There is no known remedy.
message.scp_unleashed.scp253.stage.2: Your arms and legs feel heavier than they should.
message.scp_unleashed.scp253.stage.4: The blue growths are spreading. Every step is an effort.
message.scp_unleashed.scp253.stage.5: You can barely lift your feet, and you are always hungry.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp253.query.posi: %s carries SCP-253: stage %s, %s growths, about %s min left
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp253.0: A sealed blue sample is on its way to you. Keep it sealed, and keep it away from company.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp253.1: The contact finds the reader. Stay out in the open and wait.
